name: hrow5_cbw_cx-n1-0030-COMMIT
purpose: S-ELEM-PQ/HROW 2026-10-16: closed hrow5_cbw_cx-r8b-cl-b05bb421d fails the native pin audit (R 538.5 > 300, spread 89.2 > 80, TT launch 422.8 on 991 outputs, capture 440.4 on 962 inputs; results/physical/s81_hrow_native_0030/native_audit_s81_hc_hrow_0030.json). Causes: pin flops not anchored at the faces (inhold/outhold pads only) and a W-edge clock entry into a 475.2 um wide tile through a 293-leaf spine (1,164 buffers, leaf arrival 441-512 ps). Fix: recipe 3 kit (io_flop_at_pins + pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs + HB2 pads), TritonCTS from the N-face centre; RTL, outline, macro plan, data pin faces unchanged; 0 cycles added (every port already registered in RTL; wrapper opted out with reason). dsfd_mtp_hrow_cbe (identical RTL) is retired in favour of this view (die dedupe list: REBIND cbe to cbw). Pass: TT/FF >= 0, DRC 0, native launch <= 220 / capture <= 190 / spread <= 80 / R <= 300, hrow_tiles pos PASS / mut FAIL.
